fusions.name: Raised Hackles
fusions.desc: Barges through the enemies around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Heel Nipper
fusions.desc: Nips and butts at the target's heels for 7 damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Gather the Strays
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, 1% more for each 1% of cast speed you have.

fusions.name: Flock Drover
fusions.desc: A bonded herding dog runs with you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.3 seconds.
